description: Setup: focus the last base result shelf in a local search with related titles/cast already loaded. Capture each tier; verify headings change and Back restores its parent. No acquisition actions.

steps.name: 01-context-enter
steps.review: Appended context becomes the active tier and the keyboard is closed.

steps.name: 02-context-next-tier
steps.review: Reach the next available related/cast tier. Inspect headings; route success alone does not prove deeper results.

steps.name: 03-context-parent
steps.review: Returns to the prior tier and selected card.
